About this design

Built from the supplied SketchUp model (gsquare k.skp): a U-shaped kitchen with a long counter (sink cabinet, pan pull-out, thali basket and cutlery drawer, oil pull-out, S corner), a short counter (open box with two wicker baskets, two storage doors), a tall unit with a microwave space and a tabletop-grinder space (both animated in a loop), and a glass wall cabinet.

Shutters are aqua high gloss in the colour of your reference photo, handleless with black groove profiles. The wicker box inside, the tall unit's open side and the wall cabinet's end side are wood mica from your wood photo, with the grain running vertically. White worktop, and LED profile lights under the wall cabinet and inside the OTG and grinder spaces.

Not yet specified and shown as approximations: hinge sides, light colour (warm white), sink and hob models, wicker weave, worktop speckle, the microwave and grinder models and their animation, the long counter's left end panel (aqua),. Source geometry is kept under Reference colours. Pricing has not been imported.
